title: reader::AuthConfig::is_dev_mode has no test coverage
description: stoa_auth::AuthConfig has comprehensive tests for is_dev_mode (6 tests covering required, users, credential_file, client_certs, trusted_issuers, oidc_providers). reader::config::AuthConfig::is_dev_mode has zero tests. The logic gap found in stoa-65dc6723.2 (client_certs/trusted_issuers not checked) was not caught because no test covered it. Add tests mirroring the stoa_auth config tests: not_dev_mode_when_client_certs_configured and not_dev_mode_when_trusted_issuers_configured, at minimum.
